description: This file defines an AuditListener class that listens for entity lifecycle events, specifically for persisting and updating entities to automatically set audit information like creation and modification timestamps.

classes.name: AuditListener
classes.description: A class that listens for JPA entity persist and update events to populate audit fields.

methods.name: onSaveOrUpdate
methods.description: The method called prior to saving or updating an entity, setting the audit timestamps accordingly.
